GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 413.684 (18 Jan 50) SC PO
(SCAPIN-2075/2)
APO 500
15 December 1951
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
Subject : Radar Policy
1. Reference is made to Memorandum for the Japanese Government, AG 413.684 (18 Jan 50) CCS, SCAPIN 2075, Subj: Radar Policy, dated 18 January 1950, as amended.
2. Paragraph 1 is amended to read as follows:
“1. Radar is permitted to the Japanese as a mechanical aid to navigation and is prohibited as a military device or as an adjunct to a military device.
3. Subparagraph 2a (5) is amended to read as folows:
“(5) Radar required for marine navigational use or for the safety of life at sea.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
C. C. B. WARDEN
Colonel, AGC
Adjutant General.
